jobs.title: Chief Medical Officer
jobs.description:
Job Specification:
Minimum Qualification: MBBS from a recognized and well reputed institute recognized by the Higher Education Commission of Pakistan.
MCPS in Family Medicine or equivalent foreign qualification, or higher qualification in Internal Medicine or Family Medicine, will be a plus.
Experience:
Place of Posting: Karachi Head Office
Consultancy Fee Range: Rs. 250,000 – 300,000
Minimum three (10) years' experience in healthcare administration in a corporate set up, company or hospital as on the last date of submission of application.
Job Type: Contract (02 years), extendable further as per the need of the Company by mutual agreement of both parties and subject to approval of the competent authority.
Vacancies/Slots: 01
Max. Age Limit Required: Maximum 50 years of age as on the closing date of applications.
Age Relaxation: Not applicable
IMPORTANT NOTE: Applications that do not comply with the above instructions and fail to upload all relevant documents as specified in the advertisement shall not be considered.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
The Chief Medical Officer will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following duties:
To visit PRCL Head Office daily for five (05) hours to scrutinize medical files, bills submitted by panel hospitals, etc.
To check, verify and countersign medical reimbursement claims submitted by employees and their families.
To attend to patients for consultations as envisaged in the PRCL HR Manual and issue reference letters and/or provide any other advice as prescribed under the treatment clause of the PRCL HR Manual.
To conduct medical examinations of all newly recruited employees.
To refer patients to panel hospitals and/or approved specialists, as the case may be.
To conduct random visits to panel hospitals where employees or their family members are admitted and liaise with hospital authorities to ensure the best possible treatment.
To provide technical assistance to the Administration Department of PRCL in matters relating to the provision of medical facilities.
To assist PRCL in implementing medical rules, regulations and policies relating to medical attendance.
To perform any other task assigned by the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of PRCL or any authorized officer.
TERMS, CONDITIONS & OTHER IMPORTANT POINTS:
Selection shall be made strictly on merit in accordance with the criteria prescribed in this advertisement.
The Interview Committee shall be the competent authority to finalize the order of merit based on candidate
